examples.name: Gravel bike v2
examples.description: A complete gravel bike: eleven parts (frame, fork, 700c wheel, 11-42 cassette, crankset, chain, drop-bar cockpit, seatpost and saddle, rear derailleur, brake caliper, water bottle) placed by thirteen mates in one assembly. No booleans anywhere.
features: Sprocket sketch entities and the built-in sprocket script library
PatternCircular (spokes, chainring bolts) and PatternLinear (cassette spacers, pulleys)
Pipe sweeps (chain, drop bars, saddle rails) and Revolve (rim, tire)
MateConnector features paired by Fastened and Revolute mates
examples.built_with: python3 gravel-bike-v2.py --build gravel-bike-v2.waffle (the native host, kernel-v2)
